subject: PHYSICS
title: Simple pendulum — determination of g
aim: Find the acceleration due to gravity from the slope of a graph of T² against L.
procedure: Clamp the string in the split cork and set the effective length to 40.0 cm, measured to the centre of the bob.
Displace the bob through a small angle (under 10°) and release it without pushing.
Time 20 complete oscillations. Repeat once and take the average.
Plot T² against L, draw the line of best fit and find its slope.

precautions.text: Avoided parallax error when reading the metre rule.
Kept the angle of swing small.
Started timing from the centre (equilibrium position) of the swing.
Ensured the string was firmly clamped and did not slip.

glossary.oscillation: One complete swing from one side to the other and back.
glossary.period: Time for one complete oscillation, T.
glossary.effective length: Distance from the point of suspension to the centre of the bob.
